incidents.ONLY U: Held up for clear running in the straight near the 200m and lost all momentum when closing strongly.
incidents.NOBLE PATCH: Settled at the rear and closed strongly in the final 200m to finish 3rd with fast late sectionals.
incidents.MR COOL: Settled rearward, raced keenly, held up behind runners and bumped with FLASH CURRENT when shifting out for clear running in the straight; finished 3rd.
incidents.CIRCUIT CHAMPION: Raced three wide without cover throughout the event and still fought on gamely to finish 3rd.
incidents.INFINITE RESOLVE: Settled at the back of the field and flew home down the outside in the final 400m to finish 2nd.
incidents.ALMIGHTY WARRIOR: Settled rearward and made up significant late ground in the straight to finish 3rd.
incidents.BIG RETURN: Closed strongly from the rear of the field to finish 2nd against a slow middle sectional pace.
incidents.CHILL EASY: Raced three to four wide without cover throughout the event and still sustained a strong run to win.
incidents.SMART FAT CAT: Raced wide without cover making a sustained four-wide move around the home turn to win.
incidents.SPEEDY POWER: Held up and boxed in until near the 250m, bumped another runner when shifting out and sprinted clear to win.
incidents.TYCOON EXPRESS: Swept past the field from well back in the straight to win with strong final sectionals.
incidents.POCKETING: Settled back and swept past the field in the home straight to win.
incidents.MEGASTAR HEART: Jumped well, led early and dictated throughout to win unextended.
incidents.KA YING LIGHTNING: Began speedily, led early along the outside rail over 1000m and won impressively.
incidents.JEDI SPURS: Went hard in front opening a 3-4 length lead and faded out in the final 200m. Questioned for disappointing performance.
incidents.KA YING ATTACK: Led by three lengths in the straight before tiring in the final 50m.
incidents.DROMBEG BANNER: Raced prominently setting the early pace before fading out in the home straight.
incidents.COME FAST FAY FAY: Questioned for disappointing performance; required to pass an official barrier trial and veterinary examination before racing again.
incidents.ALMIGHTY LIGHTNING: Jumped only fairly; swished tail and lost ground abruptly near the 650m (unacceptable performance concern).
incidents.TURBO GRANNY: Stood awkwardly in the gates, slow to begin and lost three lengths at the start.
incidents.STORM MIRROR: Shifted away from the rail over the final 200m but sustained run to win.
